title: My Mom Texted Me Twice. Only One Said Don't Open The Door.

notifications.title: Mom
notifications.text: Don't open it. I'm still at work.

scenes.notes: FRAME 0 = COVER: both Mom banners fully readable on the lock screen (11:40), the front door sharp behind the phone with the red EXIT strip under it broken by two feet. Punch-ins: banner 1 on 'I'm outside', banner 2 on 'Nine seconds later'.
Premise paid: the feet in the red EXIT glow. Hall light OFF (the motion sensor never fires for her).
Ownable rule + loophole on one prop. The small second line plants Lakeview Suites Rm 412 (paid at 1:35 and in the last line).

messages.text: night shift tonight. love you. lock up 🔒
Nora I'm not doing this in the hallway
I can see your shadow under the door, Nora.

scenes.notes: Warm Mom: plausible details. Nora turns the rule into a test ('Rule. Use your key.'); the group Mom overrules it by pointing at the hook.

scenes.notes: THE scariest image, once (~71%): the closet opens itself; Dad's coat, nobody in it, the sleeve still swinging; the phone in the pocket types a draft that addresses her ('turn around nora'), held still ~4 s with no music (the one intended hold over 3 s). Then her face, eyes forward; behind her the door's black gap.

scenes.notes: Rescue under red/blue. The gap closes by itself (latch click). The planted rule decides: on 'Click' the strip under the door turns from EXIT red to warm motion light, with two pairs of feet; peephole: two lit officers.
She breaks Mom's rule because the light test passed. Two officers in the lit corridor; the elevator reaches 6: Mom.
T8 after safety, NEW information: Mom's phone died at nine, so neither chat was ever her; and Marigold was only ever said out loud in our kitchen, so whatever answered had been inside our home.

messages.text: Don't open it. I'm still at work.
ur keys are right here on the hook??
Now I know whose voice you trust.
Next time, I'll call from Room 412.

scenes.notes: Her dead phone wakes. The private thread shows typing dots for the first time (the tell breaks), then the threat aimed at what she actually trusted: the Room 412 landline, read in Dad's voice. Last frame = frame 0's composition (phone over the front door). Hard cut, no CTA.
